pages.text: The $(item)Huge Meteorite Skyseed$() — a vast overworld island with a huge meteor crater, its body honeycombed with $(item)caves$().$(br2)$(bold)The cost$()$(br)End-game, like all huge seeds: a $(item)Large Meteorite Skyseed$() ringed between an $(item)Ender Pearl$() and $(item)Blaze Powder$(), packed in blackstone.
The large seed between an ender pearl and blaze powder.

$(bold)What you get$()$(br)A huge island with a massive $(item)sky-stone globe$() in its crater — sky stone in bulk — plus an internal $(item)cave system$() (sometimes sealed, sometimes opened by a sinkhole). Crack the $(item)Meteorite Core$() at its centre for $(bold)all four inscriber presses$() at once — the whole set from a single throw.
